description: This file defines a static utility class 'ManageNavPages' providing constants and methods for managing navigation highlighting and referencing pages in an ASP.NET Core MVC application.

classes.name: ManageNavPages
classes.description: A static class containing constants and methods for managing navigation states in the 'Manage' section of the web application.

methods.name: IndexNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view's active page is 'Index', otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: ChangePasswordNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view's active page is 'ChangePassword', otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: ExternalLoginsNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view's active page is 'ExternalLogins', otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: TwoFactorAuthenticationNavClass
methods.description: Returns the CSS class 'active' if the current view's active page is 'TwoFactorAuthentication', otherwise returns an empty string.

methods.name: PageNavClass
methods.description: Determines if the provided page is the active page based on the view context, returning 'active' or empty string accordingly.

methods.name: AddActivePage
methods.description: An extension method that sets the 'ActivePage' key in ViewData to the provided page name.
